lines.zh: 我在树干之间走，八条腿很轻。
lines.en: I walk between the trunks on eight quiet legs.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先到树下。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the tree before I do.

lines.zh: 落叶很厚，我的脚几乎没声。
lines.en: The leaf litter is deep, and my feet barely sound.

lines.zh: 我沿着树皮爬，一直爬到树冠。
lines.en: I climb the bark all the way to the canopy.

lines.zh: 光斑落在我背上，我躲开。
lines.en: A patch of light falls on my back, and I step aside.

lines.zh: 森林里每一步都是我的网线。
lines.en: Every step in this forest is a thread of my web.

lines.zh: 我从这棵树荡到那棵。
lines.en: I swing from this tree to the next.

lines.zh: 我走的地方，树叶自己合上。
lines.en: Where I pass, the leaves close up again.

lines.zh: 夜里我走得更快，影子帮我。
lines.en: At night I move faster, and the shadow helps.

lines.zh: 我的腿很长，跨过整条树根。
lines.en: My legs are long enough to step over a root.

lines.zh: 苔藓上有我的脚印，很浅。
lines.en: My prints in the moss are very shallow.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，像一块黑布。
lines.en: I keep low to the ground like a black cloth.

lines.zh: 三只一起走，影子叠成一片。
lines.en: Three of us walk, and our shadows merge.

lines.zh: 我不走大路，大路太亮。
lines.en: I avoid the main path; it is too bright.

lines.zh: 我从蛛网上走过去，网没动
lines.en: I walk across my web, and it does not stir.

lines.zh: 一线的月光落在地上，我绕开
lines.en: A thread of moonlight falls; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我挂在枝下，一动不动。
lines.en: I hang beneath the branch without moving.

lines.zh: 八只眼睛，各有各的方向。
lines.en: Eight eyes, each pointed a different way.

lines.zh: 丝从我的腹部出来，很慢。
lines.en: Silk comes from my abdomen, slowly.

lines.zh: 我在等叶子再动一下。
lines.en: I am waiting for the leaves to move again.

lines.zh: 森林的白天，我讨厌。
lines.en: I hate the daylight in this forest.

lines.zh: 我把腿收起来，像一粒果壳。
lines.en: I fold my legs in like a seed husk.

lines.zh: 有只飞蛾撞网了，我听见。
lines.en: A moth hit my web, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔牙，牙是凉的。
lines.en: I lick my fangs; they are cold.

lines.zh: 树影动，我也动，只是慢。
lines.en: When the tree shadows move, I move, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的丝在风里很轻地响。
lines.en: My silk whispers softly in the wind.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我织了三年。
lines.en: I have woven this wood for three years.

lines.zh: 我等的时候，比走的时候多。
lines.en: I spend more time waiting than walking.

lines.zh: 你抬头，正好看见八只眼睛。
lines.en: You look up and see eight eyes at once.

lines.zh: 你的火把把我的影子推得很长。
lines.en: Your torch stretches my shadow out long.

lines.zh: 我挂在你看不见的那根枝上。
lines.en: I hang on the branch you cannot see.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让丝在抖。
lines.en: Your breathing makes the silk tremble.

lines.zh: 你在树下停了三秒，太久了。
lines.en: You stopped under the tree for three seconds; too long.

lines.zh: 火光外缘，我慢慢挪动前肢。
lines.en: At the edge of your torchlight, I shift my forelegs.

lines.zh: 你的剑在光里闪，我讨厌亮。
lines.en: Your sword flashes, and I hate the brightness.

lines.zh: 你身后那根丝，是我留的。
lines.en: That thread behind you is one I left.

lines.zh: 我数你有几只眼睛，两只。
lines.en: I count your eyes; there are two.

lines.zh: 你看错了方向，我在你上面。
lines.en: You are looking the wrong way; I am above you.

lines.zh: 你砍断我两条腿，我还站着。
lines.en: You cut off two of my legs, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 我的血是淡绿的，粘在叶子上。
lines.en: My blood is pale green and sticks to the leaves.

lines.zh: 断了两条腿，我照样爬。
lines.en: Two legs gone, and I still crawl.

lines.zh: 我缩起来，八腿护住腹部。
lines.en: I curl up with eight legs guarding my abdomen.

lines.zh: 疼让我吐丝，丝是乱的。
lines.en: Pain makes me spin silk, and the silk is messy.

lines.zh: 你打中我一只眼，还有七只。
lines.en: You hit one eye; seven are still watching.

lines.zh: 我退上树，从上面看你。
lines.en: I retreat up the tree and look down at you.

lines.zh: 断腿会长，别高兴太早。
lines.en: Legs grow back, so do not celebrate yet.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，里面还在动。
lines.en: My shell is cracked, and something inside still moves.

lines.zh: 你砍得不错，下次从后面。
lines.en: Good cut; next time come from behind.

lines.zh: 你手里的生肉，血还是温的。
lines.en: The raw meat in your hand is still warm.

lines.zh: 一只虫子爬过你的肩，我看见了。
lines.en: An insect crosses your shoulder, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我闻到你口袋里的腐肉。
lines.en: I smell the rotten flesh in your pocket.

lines.zh: 你把火把移开，我就过来。
lines.en: Move the torch away, and I will come.

lines.zh: 树下那只兔子，比你有意思。
lines.en: That rabbit under the tree interests me more.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟的东西，太干。
lines.en: I do not eat cooked things; they are too dry.

lines.zh: 你的血味，从手腕那传来。
lines.en: Your blood smells from the wrist.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢会动的小东西。
lines.en: I prefer small things that keep moving.

lines.zh: 你把肉放下，退后五步。
lines.en: Put the meat down and step back five paces.

lines.zh: 丝在动，说明有东西上门了。
lines.en: The silk moves, so something has arrived.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的丝，脸上全是。
lines.en: You walk into my silk and it covers your face.

lines.zh: 我从枝上落下，压在你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from the branch and land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的腿很硬，蹭过会划破皮。
lines.en: My legs are hard and will break skin if they scrape.

lines.zh: 你退一步，踩断一根枯枝。
lines.en: You step back and snap a dead twig.

lines.zh: 我撞进你怀里，八条腿都张开。
lines.en: I collide with your chest, all eight legs open.

lines.zh: 你的头盔碰到我的腹部。
lines.en: Your helmet knocks against my abdomen.

lines.zh: 网被撞破的声音，像撕布。
lines.en: A torn web sounds like ripping cloth.

lines.zh: 林子里的影子都是我。
lines.en: Every shadow in these woods is me.

lines.zh: 你撞开我，丝粘在你袖子上。
lines.en: You shove me off, and silk sticks to your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你已经被标记了。
lines.en: With that touch, you are already marked.

lines.zh: 她来的方向，丝先抖了。
lines.en: The silk trembled before she came into view.

lines.zh: 我敲枝，八下，她回七下。
lines.en: I tap the branch eight times; she answers seven.

lines.zh: 她的斑纹比我深，很好看。
lines.en: Her markings are darker than mine, and fine.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用丝。
lines.en: We do not speak; we use only silk.

lines.zh: 两片影子在树干上叠起来。
lines.en: Two shadows fold together on the trunk.

lines.zh: 她把我的网修好了一角。
lines.en: She repaired one corner of my web.

lines.zh: 交配后，她可能会吃掉我。
lines.en: Afterward, she may eat me; that is how it is.

lines.zh: 森林这么大，我们还是遇上。
lines.en: The forest is vast, and we still met.

lines.zh: 她的腿比我细，跑得更快。
lines.en: Her legs are thinner than mine and faster.

lines.zh: 今年会有很多小蜘蛛。
lines.en: There will be many small spiders this year.

lines.zh: 我用丝把掉下的骨头吊起来。
lines.en: I hoist the fallen bone up with silk.

lines.zh: 那枚卵囊，我搬到树洞里。
lines.en: I carry that egg sac into a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 你丢的火把，我踩灭了。
lines.en: The torch you dropped, I stamp it out.

lines.zh: 我掉的那块肉，有人会捡。
lines.en: The meat I drop, someone will pick up.

lines.zh: 这块皮革，正好垫卵。
lines.en: This piece of leather will cushion my eggs.

lines.zh: 我不捡金属，太亮。
lines.en: I do not pick up metal; it is too bright.

lines.zh: 那只死蝙蝠，我拖上树。
lines.en: That dead bat, I drag up into the tree.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬住线头，往上拉。
lines.en: I bite the thread end and pull it up.

lines.zh: 你的箭头，我留在网里。
lines.en: Your arrowhead stays in my web.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，只用丝绑。
lines.en: When I take things, I tie them with silk.

lines.zh: 你走进林子，就已经在我的线上。
lines.en: You entered the woods, and you are already on my line.

lines.zh: 三只蜘蛛，三个方向。
lines.en: Three spiders, three directions.

lines.zh: 我最喜欢落在脖子上。
lines.en: My favorite place to land is a neck.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，把叶子都惊动了。
lines.en: Your footsteps set every leaf moving.

lines.zh: 影子从你脚边开始，那是我们。
lines.en: A shadow starts at your feet; that is us.

lines.zh: 亮的东西给我，人也给我。
lines.en: The bright things are mine, and so are the people.

lines.zh: 我选了走得最慢的那个。
lines.en: I chose the one walking slowest.

lines.zh: 头顶的丝，你还没看见。
lines.en: There is silk above your head you have not seen.

lines.zh: 你的热量在网里很清楚。
lines.en: Your heat shows clearly in the web.

lines.zh: 这片林子，进来容易出去难。
lines.en: Easy to enter this wood, hard to leave.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤，我闻到了。
lines.en: You are hurt, and I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我不追猎物，我等它自己撞。
lines.en: I do not chase prey; I wait for it to come.

lines.zh: 你头顶三米，是我的位置。
lines.en: Three meters above your head is my place.

lines.zh: 目标动了，丝就告诉我。
lines.en: The target moved, and the silk told me.

lines.zh: 我沿着丝往下，一点一点。
lines.en: I come down the thread, a little at a time.

lines.zh: 你的脖子后面，没有甲。
lines.en: The back of your neck has no armor.

lines.zh: 我把腿收拢，准备落下。
lines.en: I draw my legs in and prepare to drop.

lines.zh: 另外两只绕到你前面去了。
lines.en: The other two have circled in front of you.

lines.zh: 我等你抬头的那一瞬。
lines.en: I wait for the instant you look up.

lines.zh: 风一吹，丝就把我送过去。
lines.en: One gust of wind, and the silk carries me over.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到树冠。
lines.en: Your torch cannot reach the canopy.

lines.zh: 我停在正上方，八眼都对着你。
lines.en: I hang directly above, all eight eyes on you.

lines.zh: 你听见了响动，可你没抬头。
lines.en: You heard something, but you did not look up.

lines.zh: 我把丝放松一尺。
lines.en: I let the silk out a foot.

lines.zh: 你在树下转圈，我跟着转。
lines.en: You circle under the tree, and I circle with you.

lines.zh: 落地只要半秒，我已经算好。
lines.en: The drop takes half a second; I have timed it.

lines.zh: 你的影子告诉我你面朝哪边。
lines.en: Your shadow tells me which way you face.

lines.zh: 再一步，你就踩进网里。
lines.en: One more step and you are in the web.

lines.zh: 我从上面落在你后颈。
lines.en: I drop onto the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 牙进去的时候，你没出声。
lines.en: When the fangs go in, you make no sound.

lines.zh: 我咬完就跳开，丝还粘着。
lines.en: I bite and leap away, silk still on you.

lines.zh: 我的毒让你腿软，不是疼。
lines.en: My venom makes your legs weak, not sore.

lines.zh: 八条腿抱住你的头。
lines.en: Eight legs close around your head.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的领口，血很热。
lines.en: I tear your collar open; the blood is hot.

lines.zh: 你甩我，我顺着丝回去了。
lines.en: You throw me off, and I ride the silk back.

lines.zh: 这一口，让你看清我的眼睛。
lines.en: This bite lets you see my eyes up close.

lines.zh: 我把你往网上拖，你太重。
lines.en: I drag you toward the web, but you are heavy.

lines.zh: 咬两下，一次试，一次算数。
lines.en: Two bites: one to test, one to finish.

lines.zh: 树冠上有东西在动，是新网。
lines.en: Something moves in the canopy; that is a new web.

lines.zh: 我出卵囊，第一件事是吐丝。
lines.en: I leave the egg sac, and my first act is silk.

lines.zh: 林子里光暗，正好放我们出来。
lines.en: The woods are dim, which suits our arrival.

lines.zh: 一窝三只，各爬各的树。
lines.en: Three from one clutch, each to a different tree.

lines.zh: 我出生在树皮缝里，很小。
lines.en: I was born in a crack of bark, very small.

lines.zh: 落叶下有了动静，我们上来。
lines.en: Something stirs under the leaves, and we climb.

lines.zh: 母蛛的网还在，我先用了。
lines.en: My mother's web is still there, and I use it.

lines.zh: 这一片林子，夜里归我们。
lines.en: At night this stretch of forest belongs to us.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里出来，影子没变。
lines.en: I step out of the shade, and my shadow stays.

lines.zh: 丝挂在两棵树之间，那是门。
lines.en: Silk strung between two trees is a door.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的腿就往回缩。
lines.en: When fire comes near, my legs pull back.

lines.zh: 我从树冠摔下，丝救了我一半。
lines.en: I fall from the canopy and the silk half saves me.

lines.zh: 水灌进呼吸孔，丝也湿透了。
lines.en: Water fills my breathing holes and soaks the silk.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的网整片撕掉。
lines.en: The blast tears my whole web away.

lines.zh: 箭穿过腹部，钉在树上。
lines.en: An arrow goes through my abdomen into the tree.

lines.zh: 紫光让我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: Violet light makes my legs disobey me.

lines.zh: 网空了五天，我吃自己的丝。
lines.en: The web has been empty five days; I eat my silk.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整片林子，我无处可藏。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole wood, and I cannot hide.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，丝无处可挂。
lines.en: No trees in the void, nowhere to hang my silk.
